test_title: RRB NTPC CBT 2 (Level-3) Official Paper (Held On: 17 June 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Select the option that is related to the fifth letter-cluster in the same way as the second letter-cluster is related to the first letter-cluster and the fourth letter-cluster is related to the third letter-cluster.

PJEB : SQHI :: MCQX : PJTE :: LRCT : ?
solution:
**The logic followed here is:**

The positional values of the English alphabets are as follows:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c9e66cf17ff80cfe4968edf4f1476c07d9d4c935b8237bf90f5ed3629384f411.png] 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a9d594004fef2a6eb2e43627e8429ce1989d9fcda332b9b0bf09795c8ed5bb9d.png] 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5dd035ad549f0e76ca54411f7d7d5d52a0c506d9bca7582632396c687155d272.png] 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e939cd80b3c9470a1cbe7ece39f0ad4b929930d1bdc643c98e658a3fa27be55d.png] 

The above mentioned pattern is followed in the letter cluster.

Using the same, we deduce the required answer for the given question.

PJEB : SQHI :: MCQX : PJTE :: LRCT : **OYFA**

Hence, **OYFA **is the **correct answer.**
